capacity_usable_kwh.notes: BMW US spec table: net usable 81.1 kWh (eDrive40 and M50 same).
BMW Canada release: 83.9 kWh gross, 81.5 kWh net. US and Canadian BMW releases differ by 0.4 kWh; EV Database lists 80.7 for 2021-24.

chemistry.notes: Page: "high-voltage NMC-811 batteries"; closest enum nmc.

preconditioning.notes: Page: when navigation routes to a fast charger, anticipatory thermal management will automatically pre-condition the battery beforehand. No manual battery control found (the iDrive/My BMW app pre-conditioning passage is cabin preheating).

dc_max_kw.notes: "up to 200 kW" (US and Canadian releases agree). Other sources list 205 kW for the same car; BMW Thailand 2025 spec sheet and thinkEV list 205 for later cars.
